story:
Maya's Red Ball Day

Maya was outside. Sun felt warm. Crisp, **orange** leaves fell down. Whoosh! Maya held her **red ball**. "Red ball!" she said. Maya wanted to play. She loved her **red ball**.

A big wind came! Whoosh! Leaves flew fast. Many **brown** leaves covered the grass. "Oh no!" said Maya. "Where is my **red ball**?" Maya looked under leaves. She did not see her **red ball**.

Little Squeaky ran by. "Hello, Squeaky!" said Maya. Squeaky chittered. He looked at the leaves. Squeaky saw something **red**. He pointed his nose. "Look, look!" Squeaky wiggled. Maya helped. She moved **brown** leaves.

Then, Maya saw it! Her **red ball**! "Hooray! My **red ball**!" Maya clapped hands. Squeaky chittered happily. Maya picked up her **red ball**. She smiled at Squeaky. "Thank you, Squeaky!" Maya felt happy. She could play now!
